purpose: Freeze the frontend consumer boundary for the Equipment page before route/UI implementation. Stage 4 must consume validated Stage 3 equipment page payloads and the closed Stage B exclusive-equipment ownership indexes without reopening ConfigData semantics or re-deriving ownership.

generalList.admission: general equipment only: launch, legacy-additional, current-additional

detail.resolution: Resolve by exact numeric equipmentId across the two pairwise-disjoint public detail sets. If the ID is not in either public set, return the public not-found state; do not fall through to hidden/HOLD data.

generalListUi.subtypeSelection: zero-or-one active subtype within the active group
generalListUi.groupChangeRule: Changing the active group clears an incompatible subtype selection.
generalListUi.persistenceRequirement: Preserve the user's equipment list filter/tab UI state across revisit/reload, consistent with the site design requirement. Storage mechanism is an implementation choice for Stage 4-2.
generalListUi.taxonomyRule: Use the generated filter taxonomy and order; do not reconstruct it from raw Label values in frontend code.

name.rule: A null nameKr is an explicit REVIEW state. Fallback display must not be written back or promoted to verified Korean metadata.

displayPolicy.icon: Use the Stage 3 consumer icon field directly.
displayPolicy.effectText: Display Stage 3 effectName/effectText or effectSegments without rewriting the semantic content.
displayPolicy.restriction: Display the Stage 3 restriction block as supplied. Do not claim runtime-direct proof; current OR semantics remains structural-inference confidence 0.99.

releaseOrder.tab1: Do not claim exact historical chronology. Use the existing deterministic presentation order only.
releaseOrder.tab2: releaseGroupDate may be used for verified release-group ordering; do not invent order inside an equal release group.
releaseOrder.tab3: REVIEW_RELEASE_ORDER. sortIndex/equipmentId are deterministic fallback only and must not be labeled latest/release chronology.
releaseOrder.exclusive: Release chronology remains REVIEW for the current 167 records. Existing order is presentation order only.

exclusiveOwnership.heroMetadataJoin: Join returned heroId to data/hero-name-master.v1.json by exact heroId.
exclusiveOwnership.currentCardinality: EXACTLY_ONE owner Hero per admitted exclusive Equipment under the frozen Stage B snapshot.
exclusiveOwnership.nonDuplication: Do not generate a third ownership copy in Stage 4-0. Resolve owner Hero from the accepted B-5 byEquipment index at page composition time.
forbidden: direct ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero reads in Stage 4 page code
equipment/Hero names, descriptions, icons or numeric patterns as ownership
sortIndex, equipmentId order or release chronology as ownership

admissionPolicy.rule: Frontend publication is driven by the validated Stage 3 public consumer sets. Hidden/HOLD records must not appear in list navigation or resolve through the public detail route.

sourceDiscipline.principle: UI bugs and presentation decisions belong to Stage 4; semantic contradictions in frozen upstream data reopen the owning upstream stage instead of being patched in frontend code.

hardGates: Equipment Stage 3-7 remains PASS with 390 canonical / 373 public / 206 general / 167 exclusive / 16 hidden special / 1 explicit HOLD and zero public hidden/HOLD leak.
Stage B FINAL remains PASS_ACCEPTED and closed, with 167 exclusive ownership edges, 167 byEquipment keys and 0 general-equipment ownership admission.
General List and Detail retain exact 206-ID parity; Exclusive List and Detail retain exact 167-ID parity.
The 167 byEquipment ownership keys equal the 167 exclusive consumer equipment IDs exactly, and every owner Hero resolves in the canonical 267 Hero master.
General tab counts remain 94 / 80 / 32 and generated filter taxonomy remains weapon / armor / headgear / accessory with its frozen subtype order.
nameKr REVIEW values remain nullable with nameCn fallback only; no REVIEW/HOLD state is promoted to verified semantics in frontend policy.
soul-special 16 and equipmentId 2013 remain outside all public list/detail route admission.

completion.meaning: Stage 4 frontend implementation has a frozen, regression-checked input/admission/routing/display/ownership contract and can proceed without reading raw ConfigData for page composition.
